title: Last Admission in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Closing time is not entry time.** The Berliner Dom stops admitting people **60 minutes** before it closes, the Jewish Museum at **17:00** against an 18:00 close, and Panoramapunkt sends its **last lift up at 18:30**. Check the cutoff, not the closing time.

**Museum Island does not close as one.** The **Altes Museum and the Bode-Museum shut at 17:00 from Tuesday to Friday**, an hour before the Neues Museum, the Alte Nationalgalerie and the James-Simon-Galerie. At the weekend all five run to 18:00. Everything on the island is closed on Mondays.
**The state museums publish no last admission at all.** You can buy a ticket five minutes before closing. Treat about **60 minutes before closing** as the last arrival worth paying for.
**The Dom's summer hours end on 31 August.** From 1 September it closes at 18:00 on weekdays and **17:00 on Saturday and Sunday**, which drops the real Sunday cutoff to **16:00**.

**The reliable late options:** DDR Museum **09:00 to 21:00 every day of the year**, TV Tower to **23:00**, Topography of Terror to **20:00** and free, and the Reichstag dome to midnight with a **21:45** last admission and compulsory advance registration.
**Two days break plans.** Monday closes all of Museum Island and the Jewish Museum. Tuesday closes the Humboldt Forum, which is the one big central building that opens on Mondays.
